versions.text: Each inspection or other procedure, based on an evaluation required by USAR.572 and USAR.573, must be established to prevent catastrophic failure and must be included in the limitations section of the instructions for continued airworthiness required by USAR.1529. Cracks meeting the inspection-based requirements in terms of crack growth and residual strength shall not result in the rupture of critical parts of the structure. See also USAR.603.
